runners_data.name: Una Matata

runners_data.name: Ruff Justice

runners_data.name: Suerte

races.paceDynamic: The Liffey, Dontspoilasale, Thaloria and Suerte all want prominent positions, creating congestion and a false pace scenario with no genuine front-runner. The four hold-up horses (Benavente, Una Matata, Ruff Justice, Crest Of Light) will benefit from this tactical setup, turning it into a sprint finish where positioning 2-3 out becomes critical.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet go too fast early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The pace collapses 2f out as The Liffey and Dontspoilasale tire, allowing the closers to sweep past. Una Matata and Benavente have the class to capitalize best.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent pace holds up
scenarios.trigger: If The Liffey or Dontspoilasale can dictate a steady tempo without interference
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters gets first run and holds off the late charge in a driving finish. The Liffey's recent Dundalk form gives him the edge over Dontspoilasale.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic chaos finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes interference and blocks runs 2-3f out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery as several horses get hampered, allowing an outsider with a clear run to steal it. Crest Of Light or Ruff Justice could benefit from the chaos despite going concerns.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Going-dependent upset
scenarios.trigger: If the turf rides differently than expected, favoring proven good ground performers
scenarios.body: Horses flagged as going-dependent like Benavente or Thaloria suddenly find extra improvement. Benavente's distance stamina becomes the deciding factor in a truly-run race.

watchPoints.text: The Liffey, Dontspoilasale, Thaloria and Suerte creating a four-way battle for the lead causing early pace pressure
Una Matata and Benavente getting blocked behind the prominent congestion turning for home
Thaloria's tendency to fade in the final furlong if she gets involved in early pace battles
Going-dependent horses Benavente, Ruff Justice and Suerte if the turf rides softer than reported
Crest Of Light needing a strong gallop to suit her hold-up style after disappointing heavy ground run

races.paceDynamic: Spinning Around will lead uncontested from the start, with Bishopton, Musical Act, and Venetian tracking behind in the second rank. The sustainable early pace will allow the hold-up quartet (Blue Anthem, Um Wadi, Nikki Swango, Whistling Jamesie) to stay in touch before the final 2f turning point.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Spinning Around gets soft fractions and stays strong late
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to dictate throughout and kick clear turning for home. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Bishopton and Musical Act apply sustained pressure from 3f out
scenarios.body: The experienced prominent runners wear down Spinning Around with relentless pressure in the straight. Their tactical speed proves decisive as the hold-up horses arrive too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final 2f creating closing gaps
scenarios.body: Blue Anthem or Nikki Swango (if going suits) time their runs perfectly through the tiring leaders. The sustainable early pace becomes a liability as fresh finishers sweep past.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Spinning Around early creating a hot pace
scenarios.body: Musical Act or Venetian force the issue early, creating a genuine speed duel that opens the door. Um Wadi or Whistling Jamesie benefit from the collapse but both have finishing concerns.

watchPoints.text: Spinning Around must be monitored for early pressure as any pace challenge could expose stamina doubts
Nikki Swango's going dependency makes her highly unreliable despite strong recent handicap wins
Um Wadi and Whistling Jamesie both show concerning fade patterns that limit their finishing effectiveness
Blue Anthem needs the pace to collapse in final 2f to unleash his proven closing kick
Musical Act requires genuine speed battle to set up his sustained finishing style

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Wind will lead from the gates with Jazzy Dancer, Comfort Line and Manhattan Dandy settling prominently behind, creating a moderate early gallop over the 7f trip. The large field of 15 runners includes 9 hold-up horses who will rely on the pace-setters maintaining a solid tempo to ensure a competitive finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Genuine Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind maintains an honest gallop and the prominent horses sustain pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setters will string out the field and create opportunities for horses with tactical speed to strike from mid-division. Jazzy Dancer and Comfort Line are best positioned to capitalize from their prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Slow Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind goes too slowly early and the prominent runners fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race will become a sprint finish with hold-up horses getting first run on the leaders who will kick late. Winemaker and Roman Harry can exploit their strong finishing kicks in a bunched field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Son Of Wind Folds
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind fails to handle the good ground and drops away from the lead early
scenarios.body: Jazzy Dancer and Comfort Line will inherit the lead but may face pressure from Manhattan Dandy pushing forward. This sustained pace will favor horses with proven stamina over the 7f distance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Strong Late Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate but quickens significantly from the 3f pole onwards
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a stamina test where horses with finishing problems will struggle. Fresh horses with proven ability to stay the 7f trip strongly will emerge late.

watchPoints.text: Son Of Wind's early pace-setting - if he goes too slowly the hold-up horses will dominate the finish
Jasmine Affanalis and Roman Harry both show tendencies to fade in the final furlong when under pressure
Vibrato is going dependent and may not handle today's good ground conditions effectively
The prominent quartet of Son Of Wind, Jazzy Dancer, Comfort Line and Manhattan Dandy could create an honest pace
Watch for Winemaker and Sakakawea to be produced with late runs if the pace develops properly

races.paceDynamic: With no true front-runner in this field, the prominent runners Numidia, Jazz Forever, Hobart and Circus Act will likely create a moderate early gallop rather than genuine pace pressure. This sets up a tactical affair where the large contingent of hold-up horses (Mephisto, Slowdownbarney, Disco Boy, Black Soul, Deluca Chop, Desert Friend, Sarmiento Power) will be looking to deliver late challenges in what becomes essentially a sprint finish from the 3f pole.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical crawl sprint finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too steady early creating a slow pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from 2f out with hold-up horses getting first run. Fresh speed and tactical positioning from the rear proves decisive over stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Honest gallop suits stalkers
scenarios.trigger: If Numidia and Jazz Forever maintain genuine pace throughout
scenarios.body: The consistent tempo plays to horses that can track the pace without over-racing. Prominent runners get first run while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy pace tactical muddle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet go in snatches creating uneven fractions
scenarios.body: The stop-start nature catches some hold-up horses out of position while others benefit from the gaps. Race falls to the most adaptable tactical performer.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early breakaway sticks
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Circus Act or Hobart builds an unassailable lead while the hold-up brigade leaves their runs too late. Front-running tactics prove most effective on the day.

watchPoints.text: If Numidia and Jazz Forever both track each other instead of making pace, the race will become a crawl
Watch Hobart's jumping off - if prominent early he could steal a march on this field lacking natural speed
Slowdownbarney needs the prominent horses to go a good gallop to set up his finishing kick
Mephisto's recent question mark run needs explanation but profile suggests he's well-handicapped
Desert Friend will need career-best effort to compete with these higher-rated rivals

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runners and all horses except Lamar River being lightly raced, this looks set to develop into a messy affair where Maria Quiteria, Arrowstock or Whammy may find themselves reluctantly leading. The lack of natural pace-setters in this small field will likely create a slowly-run sprint finish where positioning and timing become crucial over raw speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Reluctant Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Maria Quiteria or Arrowstock take early initiative
scenarios.body: The reluctant leader gets an easy time in front and kicks clear when the field closes. Late challengers find the deficit too great in the shortened sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Suits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow with no horse wanting the lead
scenarios.body: The field bunches up approaching the final furlong creating traffic problems. Lamar River or another hold-up horse finds clear running late to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection Changes Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If one horse breaks the deadlock with a sustained mid-race move
scenarios.body: Belle Island or Whammy makes a telling move 2f out that catches rivals napping. The field splits with some responding and others caught flat-footed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge simultaneously in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The slowly-run race explodes into a blanket finish with several horses hitting the line together. Photo finish likely with any of the lightly-raced runners capable.

watchPoints.text: Watch for complete pace collapse if all horses refuse to take early initiative creating a crawling gallop
Monitor Lamar River's position as her hold-up style needs others to go forward but field lacks natural leaders
Observe which of the lightly raced runners shows early speed as they will likely dictate the race shape
Check for traffic problems in final furlong as slowly-run race will create bunching and potential interference
Watch Maria Quiteria's early positioning as she may reluctantly inherit the lead by default

races.paceDynamic: Wild Sapphire and Nelliestar are the only horses likely to race prominently early, but both have shown tendencies to fade in the finish. With 10 of 12 runners preferring to be held up, this sets up a crawling pace that will turn into a sprint finish over the final 2-3 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Sapphire and Nelliestar set a pedestrian gallop through the first 6 furlongs
scenarios.body: The pace quickens dramatically from 3f out as the hold-up brigade make their moves simultaneously. Higher-rated horses like Poet's Willow and Grecian Power get first run but fade, allowing fresher finishers to sweep past.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Wild Sapphire and Nelliestar fade early leaving no pace-setter
scenarios.body: The field bunches up badly through halfway with no genuine tempo, creating a messy finish where positioning becomes crucial. Late runners struggle to find daylight as the race becomes a lottery in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wild Sapphire Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Sapphire maintains a genuine gallop rather than setting a false pace
scenarios.body: The stronger tempo stretches the field more conventionally, suiting horses that can handle a truer test. Going-dependent runners struggle as the pace becomes more searching throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Nelliestar Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Nelliestar takes them along at a strong clip from the outset
scenarios.body: The unusually strong pace catches the hold-up horses cold as they're forced to race closer than ideal. Prominent racers get first run but tire, leaving the race to whichever hold-up horse can find the best passage.

watchPoints.text: Wild Sapphire's early positioning will dictate the entire race tempo - if she goes off too fast or too slow it changes everything
Gaiety Girl and Tyraxes are both flagged as going-dependent so monitor their market confidence closely
Poet's Willow has the highest rating but serious stamina doubts over this mile trip
Watch for traffic problems in the straight as 10 hold-up horses converge simultaneously
Nelliestar's jumping from the gates could determine if there's any early pace at all

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet go too fast early and create genuine pace

scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses interfere with each other and the favorites get hampered
